text:
Meera: FYI: CI canary failing for the new onnx-q8 bring-up. Lots of eval-runner backlog and duplicate work on shards, queue fills up and we hit backpressure.
Sam: any links/logs? run id?
Meera: run id 2026-03-19T14:02Z / build 4852. Paste of the tail of the eval-runner log:
```
[2026-03-19 14:02:11] INFO dispatch: assigned shard=42 -> worker=runner-7
[2026-03-19 14:02:11] WARN lease: lease mismatch for shard=42 (owner=runner-7, seen=runner-9)
[2026-03-19 14:02:11] INFO runner-9: processing batch id=ev-12845
[2026-03-19 14:02:12] ERROR kvcache: unexpected cache hit for shard=42 key=prefix-ev-12845
```

Meera: Notice two runners processing same shard at basically same timestamp.
ci-bot: build 4852 failed 3/10 tests: eval-harness throughput/regression. Full logs: https://ci/reports/4852
Jon: Hmm, that lease mismatch line looks like a race in the shard lease manager. We've seen similar when the rescheduler bumps shardEpoch but dispatch hasn't propagated.
Sam: Could the quant pipeline be changing seq_len or batch hashing so the shard key differs? I remember ONNX exporter added a small metadata change.
Meera: I checked: batch hashing uses (model_version, batch_id, seq_len) today. If seq_len changes due to padding/quant packing it can flip the key. That would explain duplicate assignment in edge cases.
Alex: Proposed quick mitigation: make shard_key = hash(model_version, batch_uuid) — drop seq_len. Also add an idempotency token on dispatch so duplicate handling is safe.
Jon: Agreed on stable key. Also, add a lease epoch bump on reschedule BEFORE dispatch to avoid two owners racing. Current flow: release -> dispatch -> bump. Flip the order.
Sam: Good. For short-term rollback: disable automatic retry fanout on the quant canary (set RETRIES=0) so we don't stampede queue.
Meera: Repro steps I used to trigger locally:
```
# start two local runners
python -m eval.runner --shard 42 --name runner-7 &
python -m eval.runner --shard 42 --name runner-9 &
# push a batch with padded seq_len via onnx-q8 exporter
./scripts/push_eval_batch.sh --model onnx-q8 --pad 8 --batch ev-12845
```

Meera: Able to reproduce ~70% of the time within a minute.
Alex: I'll open a small PR to change key + idempotency and add metric `shard_duplicate_events` and `lease_epoch_transitions` to dashboards. Will also add a short-lived alert if duplicates > 5/min.
Sam: If you tag me I'll run the canary deploy. Also add a feature flag so we can toggle the new key without full rollout.
Jon: For longer term, we should also add a deterministic test in the eval-harness CI that simulates staggered dispatch and verifies single ownership. Maybe a fuzz test for seq_len variance.
Meera: Sounds good. I'll block automatic retries and run a canary once Alex's PR lands. Will update the incident doc w/ timeline. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Alex: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/eval-runner/pulls/2124 (draft). Adds key change + metrics + feature flag.
Meera: Watching metrics. If anybody sees an alert ping here and @meera.
